patch_description: Add a sparse, positive congestion coupling between pairs of links that both enter the same node or both leave it. Their service scores combine estimated two-hop route exposure with direct demand, so pairs carrying substantial traffic are penalized more when they share a node. This approximates load balancing without adding degree penalties: the evaluator still handles degrees, while these terms distinguish which links are chosen. Keeping only the top `max(2, n // 3)` candidate links on each side of a node bounds the added interactions and varies sparsity independently of the fixed 0.24 strength.
